lines.zh: 我把勺子一样的头探进沙里，搅起一小团雾。
lines.en: I dip my spoon-shaped head into the sand and stir up a little cloud.

lines.zh: 温水海洋很浅，我游两步就能碰到海底。
lines.en: The warm ocean is shallow; two strokes and I touch bottom.

lines.zh: 我摆尾的节奏很慢，追不上任何着急的东西。
lines.en: My tail beats slowly; I could never catch anything in a hurry.

lines.zh: 我和同伴并排走，两把勺子一起搅沙。
lines.en: I cruise beside my companion, two spoons stirring the sand together.

lines.zh: 我的吻端是圆的，撞到石头也不疼。
lines.en: My snout is rounded, so rocks do not hurt when I bump them.

lines.zh: 我沿着暖流走，水越暖，我越懒得快。
lines.en: I follow the warm current; the warmer it is, the less I hurry.

lines.zh: 沙从我的鳃缝里出去，留下一条浅浅的沟。
lines.en: Sand passes out through my gills, leaving a shallow groove.

lines.zh: 我这张脸不好看，但很好用。
lines.en: My face is not handsome, but it is useful.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面游，背鳍划开一层亮光。
lines.en: I cruise just under the surface, my dorsal fin slicing the light.

lines.zh: 转弯的时候，我的头先转，身体才跟上。
lines.en: When I turn, my head goes first and the body follows.

lines.zh: 这一片海域我熟，哪块沙软我一清二楚。
lines.en: I know this water well; I know exactly which sand is soft.

lines.zh: 我慢慢下沉，像一把被放进汤里的勺。
lines.en: I sink slowly, like a spoon lowered into soup.

lines.zh: 前面有礁石，我提前一米就开始绕。
lines.en: Reef ahead; I begin my detour a block early.

lines.zh: 我不赶路，海里没有什么值得赶的。
lines.en: I do not rush; nothing in the sea is worth rushing for.

lines.zh: 我用勺头舀起一层沙，慢慢筛。
lines.en: I scoop up a layer of sand and sift it slowly.

lines.zh: 同伴在前面等我，我加快半拍。
lines.en: My companion waits ahead, so I pick up half a beat.

lines.zh: 我悬在暖水里，嘴巴一张一合，什么也没吃。
lines.en: I hang in the warm water, mouth opening and closing on nothing.

lines.zh: 勺子脸的好处是，发呆时看起来也很忙。
lines.en: The advantage of a spoon face is looking busy while idle.

lines.zh: 我在数经过的鱼，数到七就忘了开头。
lines.en: I count passing fish and forget the start at seven.

lines.zh: 这一带每群只有一两只我们，安静得很。
lines.en: Only one or two of us per group here; it stays quiet.

lines.zh: 沙里有个洞，我把吻端放进去，凉凉的。
lines.en: A hole in the sand; I rest my snout there, cool and dark.

lines.zh: 我没有掉落什么，死了也只是海水一浑。
lines.en: I leave no loot behind; my death only muddies the water.

lines.zh: 我的牙不尖，我从没想过要咬穿什么。
lines.en: My teeth are blunt; I never planned to bite through anything.

lines.zh: 温水的味道有点咸，也有点像晒过的石头。
lines.en: Warm water tastes salty, a little like sun-heated stone.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，水从嘴里慢慢出去。
lines.en: I yawn, and water drifts slowly out of my mouth.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼躲进我的影子里，我假装没发现。
lines.en: A small fish hides in my shadow, and I pretend not to notice.

lines.zh: 我保持这个姿势很久了，久到沙落满背。
lines.en: I have held this pose so long that sand settles on my back.

lines.zh: 海面在头顶碎成一片一片的光。
lines.en: The surface breaks into pieces of light above my head.

lines.zh: 我把身体摆平，让暖流从鳃里穿过去。
lines.en: I level my body and let the warm current pass through my gills.

lines.zh: 这里没什么事发生，我很满意。
lines.en: Nothing is happening here, and I am satisfied.

lines.zh: 你在岸上蹲下来，我看见一张倒着的脸。
lines.en: You crouch on the shore, and I see a face upside down.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进水里，正好罩住我的勺子头。
lines.en: Your shadow lands on the water and covers my spoon head.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，你看起来不像会游得比我快。
lines.en: I am not afraid; you do not look able to outswim me.

lines.zh: 你伸手进来，我用吻端顶了顶你的指节。
lines.en: You reach in, and I bump your knuckle with my snout.

lines.zh: 你盯着我的脸看，是因为它太圆了吗。
lines.en: Are you staring at my face because it is so round?

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，水把你也拉得有点变形。
lines.en: I look up at you, and the water bends you a little too.

lines.zh: 你笑了一下，我不知道为什么，也跟着摆尾。
lines.en: You laugh for some reason, and I wag my tail along.

lines.zh: 你的网在水里张开了，我先退半米。
lines.en: Your net opens in the water; I back off half a block first.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走了一圈，你比礁石软多了。
lines.en: I circle you once; you are much softer than a reef.

lines.zh: 你在等我靠近，我偏要再慢一点。
lines.en: You are waiting for me to come close, so I slow down further.

lines.zh: 你这一下打在我背上，沙都震起来了。
lines.en: Your blow lands on my back and shakes the sand loose.

lines.zh: 我皮厚，可你的刀比我预想的快。
lines.en: My hide is thick, but your blade is quicker than I expected.

lines.zh: 我流的血把温水染出一小片红。
lines.en: My blood stains a small patch of the warm water red.

lines.zh: 疼起来的时候我只会往沙里钻。
lines.en: When it hurts, all I can do is burrow into the sand.

lines.zh: 你砍在我的鳍上，我游起来歪了。
lines.en: You cut my fin, and now I swim crooked.

lines.zh: 我没什么可掉的，你打我只是白费力气。
lines.en: I have nothing to drop; hitting me wastes your effort.

lines.zh: 我躲进礁缝里，勺子头卡住了。
lines.en: I duck into a reef crack and my spoon head gets stuck.

lines.zh: 这一下让我彻底清醒了，也彻底饿了。
lines.en: That blow woke me completely, and made me completely hungry.

lines.zh: 我背上的口子不深，可水一进去就疼。
lines.en: The gash on my back is shallow, but water in it stings.

lines.zh: 你最好一下解决我，我不喜欢慢慢疼。
lines.en: Finish me in one blow; I dislike pain that lingers.

lines.zh: 你手里那点鱼食，味道飘了很远。
lines.en: The fish food in your hand carries a long way.

lines.zh: 我用勺子头把食物连沙一起舀起来。
lines.en: I scoop the food up with my spoon head, sand and all.

lines.zh: 一口不够，我张着嘴等第二口。
lines.en: One mouthful is not enough; I wait open-mouthed for a second.

lines.zh: 你喂我，我就不去搅你的网了。
lines.en: Feed me, and I will stop stirring your net.

lines.zh: 我把食物含在嘴里，先不咽，慢慢尝。
lines.en: I hold the food in my mouth without swallowing, tasting slowly.

lines.zh: 你撒得太散，我得绕着圈一粒粒找。
lines.en: You scatter it too widely; I have to circle for each piece.

lines.zh: 这点东西塞不满我的勺子。
lines.en: This much will never fill my spoon.

lines.zh: 我闻到虾的味道，比鱼食好得多。
lines.en: I smell shrimp, far better than fish food.

lines.zh: 我靠近了，但眼睛一直看着你的另一只手。
lines.en: I come close but keep watching your other hand.

lines.zh: 你收手太快，我只吃到一口沙。
lines.en: You pull your hand back too fast; I only got a mouthful of sand.

lines.zh: 你踩进浅水里，正好踩到我的背。
lines.en: You step into the shallows and land right on my back.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的小腿，像一把木勺敲了一下。
lines.en: I hit your shin like a wooden spoon tapping once.

lines.zh: 我不疼，我的头就是为撞东西长的。
lines.en: I am not hurt; my head grew for bumping into things.

lines.zh: 你被我一顶，往后坐进了水里。
lines.en: One nudge from me and you sit back into the water.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边打了个转，沙全糊到你鞋上。
lines.en: I turn at your feet and coat your boots in sand.

lines.zh: 这一下不是攻击，我只是没算好距离。
lines.en: That was not an attack; I simply misjudged the distance.

lines.zh: 你我都退了半步，然后互相看着。
lines.en: We both retreat half a step, then look at each other.

lines.zh: 我的吻端撞在你的膝盖上，软软的。
lines.en: My snout bumps your knee, soft and yielding.

lines.zh: 别站在我的航线上，我转弯很慢。
lines.en: Do not stand in my lane; I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 你身上留下了我勺子的印子。
lines.en: You are left with the print of my spoon.

lines.zh: 我们一对在浅湾里绕圈，谁也不抢谁的食物。
lines.en: We circle the shallows as a pair, neither stealing the other's food.

lines.zh: 我把舀到的第一口让给她。
lines.en: I give her the first scoop I gather.

lines.zh: 她的勺子头比我的窄一点，很好认。
lines.en: Her spoon head is a little narrower than mine, easy to tell apart.

lines.zh: 我们并排沉到沙上，谁也没说话。
lines.en: We sink side by side onto the sand without a word.

lines.zh: 她游过的地方，沙纹会留很久。
lines.en: The sand ripples she leaves last a long time.

lines.zh: 我把身体横过去，替她挡住上面的光。
lines.en: I turn broadside to shade her from the light above.

lines.zh: 我们只成群一两只，多了反而吵。
lines.en: We travel one or two at a time; more would be noisy.

lines.zh: 她用吻端推我，我知道她在催我走。
lines.en: She nudges me with her snout, and I know she wants to move.

lines.zh: 这一片暖水够我们两个慢慢舀。
lines.en: This warm water holds enough for us both to scoop slowly.

lines.zh: 她游远了，我沿着她搅起的沙追过去。
lines.en: She swims off, and I follow the sand she stirred.

lines.zh: 有块亮东西沉下来，我用勺子头扣住它。
lines.en: Something bright sinks; I trap it under my spoon head.

lines.zh: 我捡到一枚贝壳，含了一会儿又吐了。
lines.en: I pick up a shell, hold it a while, then spit it out.

lines.zh: 你掉的镐子太重，我推了两下没推动。
lines.en: The pickaxe you dropped is too heavy; two shoves and it stays.

lines.zh: 我把这块骨头当石头，舀起来又放下。
lines.en: I take that bone for a stone, scoop it, then set it down.

lines.zh: 我的嘴里装不下第二个东西了。
lines.en: My mouth has no room for a second find.

lines.zh: 沉下来的东西都归海底，我不过问来路。
lines.en: Whatever sinks belongs to the seabed; I do not ask where it came from.

lines.zh: 这枚铜币在水里很好看，我留下了。
lines.en: This copper coin looks fine underwater; I keep it.

lines.zh: 我用吻端把碎片推到石缝里藏好。
lines.en: I push the fragments into a rock crevice with my snout.

lines.zh: 我听见金属落水的响声，先游过去看。
lines.en: I hear metal hit the water and swim over to look.

lines.zh: 捡东西不用手，这大概是勺子的好处。
lines.en: Picking things up without hands is the spoon's advantage.

lines.zh: 你抢走了我嘴边的食物，我记住你了。
lines.en: You took the food from my mouth, and I have noted you.

lines.zh: 我慢慢抬头，勺子头对准你的方向。
lines.en: I raise my head slowly, spoon aimed your way.

lines.zh: 我锁定的东西不多，你刚好算一个。
lines.en: I do not mark many things; you happen to be one.

lines.zh: 你踩过我的沙沟，那是我舀出来的。
lines.en: You stepped over my sand groove, the one I scooped.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的影子走，影子比人好追。
lines.en: I follow your shadow; shadows are easier to chase.

lines.zh: 我不快，但我会一直朝你那个方向游。
lines.en: I am not fast, but I will keep swimming your way.

lines.zh: 你手里还有食物，所以我还没走。
lines.en: You still hold food, which is why I have not left.

lines.zh: 我的目标很简单：下一口。
lines.en: My target is simple: the next mouthful.

lines.zh: 你转身走了，我停在水里看着那个方向。
lines.en: You turn away, and I stop in the water facing that way.

lines.zh: 别误会，这不是仇恨，是胃口。
lines.en: Do not mistake this for hatred; it is appetite.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，吻端几乎贴着沙。
lines.en: I lower myself, snout almost brushing the sand.

lines.zh: 我离你还有三米，这个距离我游得很稳。
lines.en: Three blocks out, I swim steadily at this distance.

lines.zh: 你后退，我就把嘴张大一点。
lines.en: You back away, and I open my mouth a little wider.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手上的东西，不是你的脸。
lines.en: I am fixed on what is in your hand, not your face.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴开始摆得快了，这不太像我。
lines.en: My tail beats faster now, which is unlike me.

lines.zh: 水纹告诉我你在往左，我提前拐了。
lines.en: The ripples say you are going left, so I turn early.

lines.zh: 我绕到你下游，食物味都往我这边来。
lines.en: I circle downstream of you, where the food smell comes to me.

lines.zh: 汤匙似的嘴在试水温。
lines.en: My spoon-shaped snout tests the water.

lines.zh: 我的勺子头对着你，像对着一个碗。
lines.en: My spoon faces you as if you were a bowl.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就用嘴试一下。
lines.en: One block closer and I will test you with my mouth.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的裤脚，然后自己先愣住。
lines.en: I bite your trouser leg and then surprise myself.

lines.zh: 这一口没有牙印，只有一圈圆圆的压痕。
lines.en: This bite leaves no teeth marks, only a round dent.

lines.zh: 我用整个身子撞过去，重量比牙齿有用。
lines.en: I ram with my whole body; weight works better than teeth.

lines.zh: 你被顶得退了半步，我又跟上去。
lines.en: You stagger back half a step, and I follow.

lines.zh: 我咬不动你的护甲，就去咬带子。
lines.en: I cannot bite your armor, so I go for the straps.

lines.zh: 打完之后我嘴酸，得歇一会儿。
lines.en: Afterward my jaw aches and I need a rest.

lines.zh: 我的攻击很钝，钝得像被人用勺子敲。
lines.en: My attack is dull, like being hit with a spoon.

lines.zh: 你抓我的尾，我回头咬你的手。
lines.en: You grab my tail, and I turn to bite your hand.

lines.zh: 我不擅长打架，我擅长吃。
lines.en: I am not good at fighting; I am good at eating.

lines.zh: 这一下我用了全力，其实也没多大力。
lines.en: That was everything I had, which is not much.

lines.zh: 我在温水里出现，第一口就喝进了沙。
lines.en: I appear in warm water and my first gulp is sand.

lines.zh: 我一张嘴，勺子头就自己成形了。
lines.en: I open my mouth and the spoon shape forms on its own.

lines.zh: 周围有一两只同类，我们互相看了一眼。
lines.en: One or two kin nearby; we exchange a glance.

lines.zh: 这片浅湾的沙很软，正合我的头。
lines.en: This bay's sand is soft, exactly right for my head.

lines.zh: 我从水面下浮起来一点，先看看光在哪。
lines.en: I rise a little under the surface to see where the light is.

lines.zh: 出生时我最先学会的是舀，不是游。
lines.en: The first thing I learned at birth was scooping, not swimming.

lines.zh: 我的第一顿饭是沙里的一只小虾。
lines.en: My first meal was a small shrimp in the sand.

lines.zh: 水很暖，暖得我立刻就不想动了。
lines.en: The water is so warm that I immediately stop wanting to move.

lines.zh: 我落在一丛海草旁，那是个好位置。
lines.en: I arrive beside a patch of seagrass, a good spot.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼就开始找吃的，这习惯改不掉。
lines.en: I look for food the moment I open my eyes, a habit unbroken.

lines.zh: 海面在烧，我躲到最深的沙坑里。
lines.en: The surface is burning; I hide in the deepest sand pit.

lines.zh: 我被抛上岸，勺子头先着地，磕出一个坑。
lines.en: Flung onto land, I land spoon-first and dent the ground.

lines.zh: 我在岸上张嘴，鳃里只有干风。
lines.en: On land I gape, and only dry wind passes my gills.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我从水里掀起来，又扔回去。
lines.en: The blast lifts me out of the water and throws me back in.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我的背上，像一根扎进面包的签。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my back like a skewer in bread.

lines.zh: 药水味一进鳃，我的勺子头就开始发麻。
lines.en: Potion vapor enters my gills and my spoon head goes numb.

lines.zh: 我已经舀了一整天的沙，什么也没舀到。
lines.en: I have scooped sand all day and caught nothing.

lines.zh: 闪电落进浅湾，我的整条背脊都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the shallows and my whole spine lights up.

lines.zh: 我掉出水面，勺子头朝上，越掉越远。
lines.en: I fall out of the water spoon-up, dropping farther and farther.
